answer: Reciprocity balancing stops sybil aliases from only taking work and never giving any. Each alias must post one real job for every five jobs it takes, and posted jobs wait in a lagoon pool where any alias can claim them. A bridge record ties each posted job to its alias, so every posted-to-taken ratio stays visible. An alias below the ratio may take at most 2 jobs per epoch, and an alias that posts a fake job with no real brief loses its last 10 completed jobs and sits out 14 epochs. The summit ceiling is 10 jobs per epoch, open only to aliases above the ratio.
